denominator.note: Every payment a block was actually READ FROM, wherever it ended up, counted where the coverage is counted rather than derived from bucket sums. A refusal that carries a block IS counted: requiresDecisionAttestation produces refusals CAUSED BY the block, and an exclusion rule that its own new case falsifies is not a rule. See fromRefusals and fromRoutedPayments, which sum to this value.

grouping.note: The per-agent denominators must sum to the fleet denominator. If they do not, the grouping is dropping records the aggregate counted, and every per-agent rate is over a smaller population than it appears to be. THIS ROUTE REFUSES rather than reporting that state: a mismatch throws and no response is served, so this field is `true` on every response that exists. Do not branch on it. It is asserted by the route exactly as the reserved population asserts its partition, and for the same reason: a correction a consumer must go and find is a correction most consumers will not find.
